purpose: Hold model, tasks, generation, logical policies, and agent-neutral record semantics fixed before the Paper 8.5 to Paper 4.5 bridge.

task_cohort.selection_rule: The three already-used cross-agent Django identities, frozen without outcome-dependent replacement for this model.

atomicity: failed action plus error plus recovery

policies.boundary_rule: An oversized oldest admitted tool observation may be shortened only in ordinary-text logical evaluation.
policies.native_engine_rule: Keep the same selected record ID but round up to its complete original resident K/V span; never encode the shortened replacement after source-cache creation.

policies.boundary_rule: Use genuine user-instruction provenance only; consume no task ID, episode marker, evaluator boundary, workspace status, or agent ID.
policies.native_engine_rule: Select or omit complete original-position resident record spans only.

agents.rule: An agent enters a selective arm only on identities its matched FULL arm resolves officially.

engines.logical_ledger_rule: Every engine consumes the exact exported plan digest and selected record IDs. The selector is not rerun per engine.

gates.plain: Official task resolution is required before a treatment is interpreted.
gates.pra100: Matched-consumer semantic parity, original-position parity, zero selected-history re-encoding, and complete physical telemetry are required.
gates.reduced: Compare against a matched fresh consumer of the identical selected subset; do not require equality to FULL.
gates.persistent: Require zero lost paired FULL successes and no aggregate action or call increase before promotion.
